parts.text: Six hundred years ago, Sir John Hawkwood arrived in Italy with a band of soldiers and settled near Florence.副词短语作时间状语开头（复合句） 造句：As long ago as 1994, I arrived in Beijing with my parents and settled near the Temple of Heaven.早在1994年，我就随父母到了北京，并在天坛附近定居了下来。 settle down 安定下来（浪子回头） He soon made a name for himself and came to be known to the Italians as Giovanni Acuto. 主谓结构开头（复合句） A be known to B as ... B把A称为⋯ 造句：Li Bai is known to the Chinese as 'poet-immortal'. 中国人把李白称诗仙 造句：Basketball player Earvin Johnson soon made a name for himself and came to be known to the Americans as 'Magic Johnson'. 篮球运动员埃尔文·约翰逊迅速出名了，并且美国人开始把他称为“魔术师约翰逊“。 Whenever the Italian city-states were at war with each other, Hawkwood used to hire his soldiers to princes who were willing to pay the high price he demanded . 让步状语从句开头（复合句） In times of peace, when business was bad, Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state and, after burning down a few farms, would offer to go away if protection money was paid to them. 介词短语作时间状语开头（复合句） 造句：As long ago as the 1930's, the Red Army had completed the successful Long March during which they covered 25,000 li.早在20世纪30年代，红军就完成了伟大的长征，在这期间他们走过了25,000里。 除了使用If做条件还可以使用下面的 In spite of this , the Italians regarded him as a sort of hero . 介词短语作让步状语开头（简单句） regard sb. as 视为，认为 When he died at the age of eighty, the Florentines gave him a state funeral and had a picture painted which was dedicated to the memory of 'the most valiant soldier and most notable leader, Signor Giovanni Haukodue’. 时间状语从句开头（复合句） a state funeral 国葬 造句：When Ronald Reagan died at the age of 93, the Americans gave him a state funeral and had a statue built which was dedicated to the memory of the great president.当罗纳德里根在93 岁去世时，美国人为他举行了一次国葬，并请人塑了一尊塑像以纪念这位伟大的总统。 高级作文句子要领 Sentence opening is very important to create sentence variety.
They'd like to see their daughter settle down, get married, and have kids.

rows: After I had sat down, he said that business was very bad . The credit card business is down, and more borrowers are defaulting on loans. 信用卡生意正在走下坡路，更多的借贷人不履行还贷责任。 This shop is very quiet; not much business is done. 这家店铺冷冷清清的， 没有什么生意。

headers: offer to do ... 主动提出做某事
volunteer to do ... 自愿提示做某事
rows: I think you might at least offer to help! 我认为你至少应该主动提出帮忙吧！

headers: as / so long as ... 只要...
on condition (that) ... 只要满足这个条件就
rows: We'll hold the concert on next Monday provided / providing that the weather is good. 如果天气好的话，我们将在下周一举行音乐会。
I will join the club provided / providing that you do too. 我愿意加入俱乐部，如果你也愿意的话。
'So long as there's something to identify, we will give people their money back,' said a spokeswoman for the Bank .
John will go on condition that Mary is invited too. 约翰愿意去，条件是玛丽也得到邀请。
She will go only if Peter goes. Only if Peter goes will she go . 位于句首时引起部分倒装
